prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent full-body character group for Lesson 11–12 in the established Canran learning journey map.
Input images, in order: Image 1 is the approved map world and cheerful warm art direction, not a UI to reproduce. Image 2 is the EXACT rendering and compact character-proportion master: very rounded large heads, about three heads tall, bold warm-brown outlines, simple expressive smiles and soft bright colored shapes. Images 3 and 4 provide the existing teacher, Dave and Tim identities and shirt-return story; preserve those identities and outfits but redraw them in the more compact, large-headed Image 2 style. Do not copy the tall slender proportions of Image 4.
Primary scene: three people warmly confirming the owners of two returned shirts. Teacher at the left, Dave in the center slightly behind, Tim at the right. Teacher and Tim are jointly holding the SAME ONE WHITE collared short-sleeved shirt between them during a hand-back; Dave proudly holds his own ONE BLUE collared short-sleeved shirt against his chest. Exactly TWO loose shirts total, one white and one blue; no duplicate white shirt. This is returning belongings, not shopping, not buying, not giving a wrapped present.
Teacher: friendly mature man, gray-brown side-parted hair, rectangular dark brown glasses, sage-green jacket over white collar and golden-yellow tie, gray-blue trousers, brown shoes. He is only modestly taller than the boys, with a rounded large head and friendly smile. Dave: light-brown curly hair, golden-yellow top, gray-blue overalls, brown shoes, holding the blue shirt. Tim: dark-brown short gently spiky hair, terracotta sweater with exactly two pale-yellow horizontal stripes, olive trousers and brown shoes, receiving the white shirt from teacher. Keep all faces clear and all hands anatomically readable; nobody's face is covered by the shirts.
Composition: horizontal canvas about 1536x1024. A compact three-person group, full bodies and ALL six shoes visible; approximately 75–82 percent of canvas width and 80 percent of height, with 8–12 percent genuinely transparent margin all around. Teacher's left body, Dave's central body, and Tim's right body remain identifiable. Feet align on one consistent near-bottom baseline; Dave may be very slightly behind but keep his complete shoes visible. Friendly slight three-quarter view matching the master, not isometric objects.
Style: polished children's storybook game characters, thick rounded warm dark-brown contours, softly modeled bright cheerful color blocks, gentle cream highlights and warm shadows, uncluttered and readable at small map scale. Match Image 2 line weight, round faces, soft nose, blush and compact proportions. No realism, no anime, no long thin legs.
Background: genuine transparent alpha only, including gaps between limbs and people. No flat white background, no checkerboard artwork, no scenery, no building, no clothes rack, no hanger, no ground plane or platform, no ground shadow, no border. No labels, letters, numbers, UI, stars, medallion, glow, watermarks or extra people. Generate only this complete three-person character group and their two shirts.

refinement.reason: Initial output left about 2% bottom margin and did not make the second sweater stripe sufficiently clear.
